scripts.typecheck: for d in packages/ir packages/discover packages/model packages/adapters packages/session packages/exec packages/bash-parse packages/ext packages/auth packages/agent packages/tui apps/kimi-next; do (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:loc && bun run check:arch && bun run check:golden
scripts.clean: for d in packages/* apps/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || continue; (cd "$d" && bun run clean) 2>/dev/null || true; done
